sloka: धिक्करिष्यन्ति रथ्यासु सुरापम् ब्राह्मणम् यथा ।अहो दुःखमहो कृच्छ्रम् यत्र वाचः क्षमे तव ॥२-१२-७९॥
transliteration: dhikkariṣyanti rathyāsu surāpam brāhmaṇam yathā ।aho duḥkhamaho kṛcchram yatra vācaḥ kṣame tava ॥2-12-79॥

translations.english: What suffering What a calamity that I am made to put up with your words. I am subject to this suffering may be as expiation for the sin formerly committed.
